gen_assessment.reasoning: Fever at presentation matches gold cc-001. 'General malaise' is not explicitly in the gold facts but is consistent; no contradiction.

7-day history of fever with sweats, muscle aches, nausea, fatigue aligns with gold hpi-001 (one-week fever with sweatiness, body/muscle aches, nausea, fatigue). Omits night sweats and hot/cold episodes; no contradiction.

Sweating and chills are consistent with gold hot/cold episodes and sweatiness. 'Without a specific pattern' is extra and not mentioned in gold; still plausible, so treated as addition, not contradiction.
Gold: OTC ibuprofen and paracetamol only slightly reduce temperature and otherwise not helping. Generated: provide slight relief of symptoms. Both indicate only slight benefit; no conflict.
Travel to Vietnam and rural activities are supported. Specifics of 'four weeks ago' and omission of urban tourism/trekking/cycling are additions/omissions but not contradictory.
